name: API Orchestrator - Export
description: Export API Orchestrator request data to CSV, Excel, PDF and JSON, plus scheduled emailed reports.
project_description: API Orchestrator - Export provides data export for API Orchestrator request logs in CSV, Excel, PDF and JSON formats via ExportService, an export/download admin page, and a scheduled-reports system (ScheduledReportService) that emails periodic exports to configured recipients on cron. Scheduled report definitions are stored in the api_orchestrator.scheduled_reports config object. The report toggle route is POST + CSRF protected. Requires api_orchestrator. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
